name: Death Tracker Pro
description: Tracks every attempt and death per level: death map, progress graph, session stats and a detailed stats menu. Data is saved between sessions.

hud-enabled.name: Session HUD
hud-enabled.description: Shows attempts, deaths and best percentage for the current session while you play.

hud-corner.name: HUD corner
hud-corner.description: Where the session HUD is placed on screen.

hud-opacity.name: HUD opacity (%)
hud-opacity.description: How visible the session HUD is.

accent-color.name: Accent color
accent-color.description: Main color of the stats menu, charts and HUD highlights.

death-map-bucket.name: Death map detail (% per bar)
death-map-bucket.description: How many percent points each bar of the death map covers. 1 = most detailed.

track-practice.name: Track Practice Mode
track-practice.description: Also record attempts and deaths made in Practice Mode (they never change your normal best %).

pause-button-corner.name: Pause menu button corner
pause-button-corner.description: Where the Stats button appears in the pause menu.
